svg.text: HIGH-THROUGHPUT OFFLINE BATCH INFERENCE: PREFIX/LENGTH SORTING, MAX-BATCH & SPOT GPUS
Prefix-Grouped & Length-Sorted Bucketing + Spot Max-Batch Hits 4,680 Tok/s/GPU (-84.9% Cost)
Nightly 2M-Document Extraction (7.9B Tokens): Tier 1 Online HTTP ($18,900) vs. Tier 2 Cloud Batch API ($9,450) vs. Tier 4 ($2,850)
⛔ Tier 1 & 3 Traps: Online Caps & Unsorted Thrashing
1. Sending Offline Batch Jobs Through Real-Time HTTP Endpoints:
• Online pools cap batch size (`B=32–48`) to protect `<25ms` TPOT—
leaving `74%` of the GPU's Roofline compute throughput unused!
2. Random Prompt Order Thrash-Evicts the Prefix Cache (`38%` Hit):
• Interleaving 25 different extraction schemas in random order
continually evicts and recomputes system prompt KV blocks!
3. Mixing 500-Token & 32K-Token Docs in One Batch:
• Causes severe ragged prefill-decode interference & tail stalls
Tier 1 Online Endpoint Misuse Impact (2M Docs / 7.9B Tok):
• Sustained Output Throughput: Only 1,120 tok/s/GPU
• Prefix Cache Hit Rate: 38.0% | Duration: 14.8 hours
• Cost per Nightly 2M-Doc Run: $18,900 ($9,450 on Cloud Batch API)
🏆 Tier 4: Prefix/Length Sorting + Max-Batch Spot GPUs
1. Global Pre-Sorting by `(Schema_Prefix_Hash, Input_Length)`:
• Groups all docs sharing a schema together (`99.4%` Prefix Cache
hit!) and buckets by length so sequences finish together!
2. Roofline-Saturated Offline Batch (`B = 256–512`, `4,680 tok/s`):
• Relaxes TPOT to `55ms` to drive Decode arithmetic intensity right
onto the TensorCore flat roof (`4.18x` higher output TPS/GPU!)
3. Spot / DWS Flex GPUs + 10K-Doc Parquet Shard Checkpointing:
• Commits every 10,000 docs to Parquet so Spot preemption loses <30s
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (2M Docs / 7.9B Tok):
• Sustained Output Throughput: 4,680 tok/s/GPU (4.18x vs. Tier 1!)
• Prefix Cache Hit Rate: 99.4% | Completion Time: 3.4 hours
• Cost per 2M-Doc Run: $2,850 (-84.9% vs. Tier 1, -69.8% vs. Batch API)
